title: Grand Theft Auto VI — PS5 trophies
missable_rule: Missable means tied to a single named story mission or a one-off story beat. Story missions can usually be replayed, so treat a flag as 'do it when it comes' rather than 'gone forever'.

source_legend.official: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: the official names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them
source_legend.psn: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy guide: progress targets and counts
source_legend.advice: This atlas's own advice, read off the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy and this one unlocks by itself. Follow the roadmap in order — story, strangers, activities, collectibles, cleanup — and the platinum is the last pop, not a separate chase.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn — it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies come from story progress alone: keep following the story missions and this pops at the chapter's close.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Like the other chapter trophies it needs nothing but story progress — it pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. Keep following the story missions; the trophy pops at the chapter's close.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end — the last chapter trophy before the finale. Story progress only.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It pops when the mission ends. Flagged because it is a single mission — play it when it comes; mission replay is the fallback if a run goes wrong.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It appears in the story flow — play it when it comes up and the trophy pops at the end of the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A heist in the story flow — play it when it appears; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It arrives in the story flow — play it when it appears and the trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. A named mission in the story flow — play it when it appears; the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. Play it when it appears in the story flow; the trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A named mission — play it when it appears in the story flow and the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: every story mission, stranger strand, activity, collectible and challenge the game counts. This is usually the last trophy earned. The in-game stats page shows your percentage — use this atlas's per-kind progress and the roadmap's cleanup phase to find what's left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses and stunt moves the game counts. They add up across the whole game, so don't grind them early: play normally, watch the counter, then mop up the rest late with repeated jumps in open areas.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once — races, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, drone races and the rest. One try each is enough; you don't need to win or master any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Practice each range until the gold score is yours — steady aim beats speed. Expect several attempts per challenge; this is a skill trophy.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. Learn each course with a practice run first, then race to win — the trophy needs a win everywhere, not just once.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same one 20 times. Work through the race list across Leonida; variety is the requirement.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are timing and patience — match the prompt, don't rush the reel. Challenge Cal once fishing unlocks and keep at it until you out-fish him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game all the way through. Pick the shortest game in the arcade and play it to its end — completion is what counts, not a high score.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Stranger missions unlock as you meet people across Leonida — follow Andy's strand to its end. A single mission, so do it when it appears.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Follow Kenton's stranger strand to its end — a single mission, so do it when it appears.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Follow Billy's stranger strand to its end — a single mission, so do it when it appears.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands. Strangers are marked across the map — meet them and follow each strand to its end. There are more strangers than the eight you need.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Follow Randy's stranger strand to its end — a single mission, so do it when it appears.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Follow Tyrone's stranger strand to its end — a single mission, so do it when it appears.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. The spots are quiet places the game marks — work through them region by region so none is left. The official description doesn't name the spots, so this atlas doesn't pin them down.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Unique animals are one-of-a-kind spawns — follow Bret's strand and the hunt leads you to it. Bring a good rifle and patience.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — collect them as you explore and chase down the missing ones. Three complete sets is the target.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 different locations. It's a count trophy — use it everywhere you go and the number climbs. Make it a habit and it finishes on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges are the game's small goals — do the easy ones first and the count builds. Any 50 count.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The partner has to be present — that is the condition. Break line of sight, switch vehicles and lay low until the heat dies. A story-timed partner moment, so it is flagged.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without dropping your wanted level between them. Plan a route past three shops, keep moving, and keep your partner with you for all three. A story-timed partner moment, so it is flagged.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Drive around Leonida and hop into anything new — the game logs each discovery. Variety across the map fills this out; it finishes on its own if you keep trying new rides.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns while it lasts. Crowded fights are your friend — don't waste it on a single enemy.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — grab a plane and go on your own terms, without following the script. VCIA is the airport; an unscheduled departure means taking off when nobody scheduled you to.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description jokes about Rhino tanks — get into a Rhino and stir up trouble. Expect heavy resistance; the tank is the point, so use it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean — no detection at any point. Go quiet: no alarms, nobody spotting you. If you're seen, leave and try again; a clean run is the requirement.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and get away clean each time. Plan the escape before the robbery — a fast car and a route out matter more than the vault itself. Five clean escapes is the count.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes — intercept one, crack it, and be gone before the response arrives.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit everywhere in Leonida — every region on the map. Drive, fly or sail to each corner; the trophy pops when the last area is discovered. The map's fog is your guide: any grey area is somewhere you haven't been.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Every gang has operations — find one per gang and rob it. Street talk and the map point to them; one per gang is the requirement.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This reads like a one-off story beat — do it when the moment comes in the story. Ocean Beach is the setting; the cocktail is the trigger. Flagged because it is a single moment.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — a set-piece moment. When the scene comes, drive straight through. One-off beat: don't drive past it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — a story beat at the lanes. Play it when it comes; it is a single moment, not a repeatable activity, so it is flagged.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment — the description is deliberately vague, and this atlas doesn't invent the details. It reads as a story beat about the partnership; play the story and it comes. Flagged as a one-off story beat.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A choice trophy — decisions you make in the story have consequences, and this pops for one of them. There is no way to know which choice until players map it; this atlas flags it as choice-dependent rather than guessing.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description hints at a second attempt — something you fail once and get right the second time. Treat it as a story beat that needs a retry; this atlas doesn't invent which moment it is.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A 'what just happened' moment — clearly a story beat, and deliberately cryptic. Play the story; when something strange happens, this is likely it. This atlas doesn't guess the scene.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock people over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat, not a gun. Slow down near a group, swing, and keep driving.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and robberies — move them through contacts over time and the total adds up. There is no single big score; steady laundering gets there.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops across Leonida — clothes, weapons, food, anything. It adds up over a normal playthrough; big purchases at the end mop up the rest.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in the game. Garages are bought with in-game money — save up and purchase each one; the trophy pops at the last. Check the map for properties you haven't bought yet.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, register them through the app, and repeat until ten are logged. Any ten vehicles count.
